scope: Grouped branch tabs, data expansion, linked navigation, empty/failure/no-JS states

tests.name: Grouped branch tabs switch summary, facilities, trainers and contact together with explicit targets
Branch tab keyboard navigation, URL/session restore, direct links, and same-tab announcement return
Branch data expansion creates all tabs/panels and keeps many mobile tabs within horizontal scrolling
Empty optional data hides photo/trainer blocks, shows news empty state, and preserves core inquiry
Failed photographs and simulated unavailable map keep content, address, and inquiry readable
Blocked app script and disabled JavaScript retain mobile menu, content, addresses, and branch contact text
No unexpected script or resource failures outside deliberately broken fixtures

skipped: Popup period boundaries, publication, activation, and Korean midnight
Separate popup, display acknowledgement, close, once per tab, manual reuse, and connected post
Blocked automatic popup is normal when manual entry succeeds; no false shown record
Mobile layer opens without a new tab; close restores scroll/focus, traps focus, and supports short screens
Mobile today hide, manual reopening, same-tab post, and unavailable storage
Today hide persists across tabs until Korean midnight and manual reopening remains available
Direct popup URLs enforce expired, future, disabled, unpublished, and missing-post fixture conditions
Popup content-loading failure is not counted as displayed; manual retry recovers the same window
Unavailable storage preserves manual entry and reports inability to save today hide
limitations: No real map, telephone, or KakaoTalk integration
No physical device or other-browser verification
State screenshots still require user visual review
